_comment: Phrase set of every function of DB/Functions/function-map.json: what players type (phrases: names, synonyms, slang, paraphrases; descriptions: everyday sentences; de: German) to find that function. The quality gate's I11 (engine relations phrase-check) checks every phrase on every entry point offline. ambiguous_with: functions a phrase may also mean (top-2 is enough).
